items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 3:1
items.html: In truth, only the Nekudot of SAG are considered to be above the Nekudim, and not the Taamim of SAG, as explained in Inner Observation, Part 6. However, through the raising of MAN, the Nekudot of SAG are found joining with the Taamim of SAG into one, and the Nekudot do not rise by name. (Inner Light, page 601, Sub Header, “The Mochin”)
